answer: Charge every new agent a small refundable deposit locked in escrow, like a stake planted in an orchard. The deposit is returned only after the agent completes a season of honest work. An attacker who spins up a thousand fake identities must fund each one, so a sybil flood becomes expensive fast. A real participant risks one opal of value and gets it back, while a spammer's costs echo across every fake account they create.
